notes: WH Group Limited (HKEX: 0288) — world's largest pork producer. Owns 100% Smithfield Foods (US), Shuanghui Development (China; A-share 000895.SZ ~70%), and European pork operations (Goodvalley + Morliny). Reports in USD-millions (functional currency due to mix). Lists in HKD on HKEX. Floated Smithfield Foods on NYSE/Nasdaq Jan 2025 (SFD; ~20% of subsidiary). FY ends Dec 31. All figures USD-mm consolidated IFRS. Net debt company-defined (incl. lease liabilities under IFRS 16).

periods.notes: FY20: Pandemic surge in US retail meat demand offset by HRC weakness. Revenue $25.6bn, EBITDA $2.83bn (margin 11.0%). Strong China hog cycle still elevated.
H1 21: Revenue $13.3bn. China pork prices declining post-ASF rebuild.
FY21: Revenue $27.3bn (+7%) on US foodservice recovery; EBITDA $2.57bn — China pork prices collapsed (post-ASF herd rebuild) compressed Shuanghui margins.
FY22: Revenue $28.1bn (+3%), EBITDA $2.85bn (margin 10.1%). US Smithfield benefitted from elevated hog prices; China business stable.
FY23: Trough year — US fresh pork posted operating loss on excess hog supply + processor oversupply; revenue $26.2bn (-7%), EBITDA $2.27bn (margin 8.6%), NI $626M. Buyback retired ~9% of shares.

FY24: Strong recovery in US fresh pork (margins normalized), record packaged meats profit. Revenue $26.2bn (flat), EBITDA $3.20bn (margin 12.2%), NI $1.48bn (+136% YoY). Leverage <0.6x. Smithfield IPO completed Jan 2025.
